name: Yuzu
source:
Favorite things: Sports, Tatsuki

Yuzu is Tatsuki’s childhood friend. She’s pretty weird and comes into his room through the window and such, and often tries to butt into his life. She also makes him food occasionally. Also a self-proclaimed "realist" who tries to do things “acceptable to societies”.
